body:
TF2Tools 6.1 adds a Graphics page for mastercomfig, a logs.tf page with your stats and your teammates', GameBanana maps on the Maps page and add-ons in the Addon Store, plus a long list of HUD Maker and store fixes.

## What's Changed

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v6.1.0 -->

### New features
* Choose mastercomfig graphics presets from a new Graphics page by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1136
* Change single mastercomfig settings on the Graphics page by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1138
* Pace GameBanana requests and say when it is busy by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1148
* Browse GameBanana skins, effects, GUIs, textures and game files in the Addon Store by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1152
* Install, update and remove GameBanana add-ons from the Addon Store by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1154
* Add a logs.tf page with class averages and logs for you and your teammates by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1160
* Open logs.tf logs like the site, and choose how far back to go by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1164
* Show weapon icons from your own TF2 install by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1177
* See a player's weapon stats per class on the logs.tf page by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1178
* Show the game's weapon names on the logs.tf page by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1179
* Show kill-feed icons beside weapons on the logs.tf page by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1180
* Browse GameBanana maps on the Maps page by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1159
* Update GameBanana HUDs from the HUDs page by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1182
* Add HUDs, sounds and crosshairs to a profile from where you see them by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1191
* Your own stats on each logs.tf match row, and a tidier page on wide screens by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1195
* Nicknames for players you follow on the logs.tf page by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1196
* Sort the kill matrix and the class table on the logs.tf page by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1202
* Null-Canceling Movement addon sets up your movement keys by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1218
* The GameBanana map list loads once and refreshes in the background by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1245
### Fixes
* Make sure failed font, HUD copy and sound actions explain why by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1125
* Say a HUD is gone, not a database error, when it is deleted mid-copy by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1128
* Ask for the mastercomfig update before swapping the sound or decals file by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1139
* Store cards light up when you hover them by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1143
* Keep the store sync count inside its banner in a small window by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1157
* Keep the window buttons whole when the header is full by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1158
* Finish a store sync at the end of a GameBanana listing instead of calling it busy by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1184
* Remove TF2's sound cache file with a GameBanana add-on by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1186
* Remove TF2's sound cache file with a hitsound or killsound by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1188
* Every weapon on the logs.tf page shows its icon by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1201
* Each class on the logs.tf page lists only its own weapons by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1203
* Small crosshairs no longer repeat four times in game by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1204
* HUD Maker freeze cam looks like the game's by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1208
* HUD Maker rank panel looks like the game's level bar by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1209
* HUD Maker KOTH timer shows one clock counting down by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1212
* HUD Maker offers a HUD option on its part even while it is off by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1213
* HUD Maker places pinned parts the way the game does by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1224
* HUD Maker class select has the game's shades by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1225
* HUD Maker spectator scenes match the game by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1226
* HUD Maker win panel keeps the HUD around it by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1229
* HUD Maker situations match the game: dying, low ammo, Medic charged, Bounce by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1230
* HUD Maker KOTH clocks sit in the game's frame, in the HUD's colours by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1231
* HUD Maker: item meters draw like the game by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1233
* HUD Store: show HUDs that don't list an operating system by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1235
* HUDs install in lowercase on Linux so TF2 loads them by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1240
* HUD Maker: the match status frame and avatars around the round timer by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1241
* Pyro reflect kills show the reflect icon on the logs page by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1244
### Usability and accessibility
* Edit profiles on their own page by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1140
* Say Close TF2 first before asking to remove an add-on by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1187
* A compact class table on the logs.tf page by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1197
* HUD fonts dialog wraps its warnings by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1214
### Performance
* Open GameBanana lists quickly while a store sync runs by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1183
### Other changes
* Credit mastercomfig, hud-db, GameBanana and serveme.tf, and update the Valve notice by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1134
* List the Graphics and Maps pages in the README by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1170


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/compare/v6.0.2...v6.1.0

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x64 | [TF2Tools.exe](https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/releases/download/v6.1.0/TF2Tools.exe) |
| Linux x86_64 | [tf2tools_6.1.0_x86_64.AppImage](https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/releases/download/v6.1.0/tf2tools_6.1.0_x86_64.AppImage) for most Linux systems, or [tf2tools_6.1.0_amd64.deb](https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/releases/download/v6.1.0/tf2tools_6.1.0_amd64.deb) for Ubuntu and Debian |

Each file also has a copy with no version in its name, for links that always point at the latest release. Check a download with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`. To check that a file was built by GitHub from this project's own code, use `gh attestation verify <file> --repo PhongGuy/TF2Tools`.

## Before you install

- **Windows:** Windows may show a blue box saying "Windows protected your PC". TF2Tools is free and not signed with a paid certificate, so Windows does not recognise it yet. Click "More info", then "Run anyway". Only do this for the file from this page. TF2Tools 6 installs next to TF2Tools 4. Once it works, you can remove TF2Tools 4 in Windows Settings > Apps.
- **Linux AppImage:** after downloading, right-click the file, open Properties, allow it to run as a program, then double-click it.
- **Linux .deb:** open it with your software installer and click Install.

## Updates

On Windows and with the AppImage, TF2Tools checks for new versions and installs them itself after checking their signature. The .deb does not update itself; get new versions from the [Releases page](https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/releases).
